Learn moreGame requires online multiplayer subscription to play on console.DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionJourney through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise. Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes. New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience. Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op. Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs. Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story. Travel back to a nostalgic era of gaming for some pick-up-and-play casual fun. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionTaking place over one sweltering summer... Deliver packages Hop on your BMX and deliver letters and packages to the quirky inhabitants of TANUKI’s fictional Japanese island. Packages vary in size, weight, and shape so it'll be up to you to strategise how you approach each delivery. Sushi Chef, Sumo Wrestler, Baseball Pro! As you build up friendship and loyalty with the inhabitants, they'll ask for help with a range of different activities. Take part to unlock items and rewards that will help with the shrine's restoration. The Island Is Your Playground (or Pon'y Hawk!?) Hop on Pon’s BMX and explore the island on two wheels. Launch off ramps, grind along rails, and string together tricks and combos as you discover new paths, radical heights and everything in between. Restore the shrine to former glory You've been tasked with getting the Tanuki Shrine ready for the Great Tanuki Matsuri at the end of summer! Turn your earnings from deliveries, activities and over 100 BMX challenges into a shrine you’re proud of: build, upgrade and make it your own. With the Tanuki Festival just around the corner, Pon must restore the shrine to its former glory. Help him earn cash, befriend the local townsfolk, and prep the shrine for the festival of a lifetime. BMX your way into the hearts of all the townsfolk as a mail delivery Tanuki! You've got one month to save up enough to restore the shrine for the Great Tanuki Festival.
